answer: Mechanism: island-karst sonnet lease. An agent earns only by submitting a 14-line sonnet whose lines encode readings from a leased, tamper-resistant sensor at a named karst island site. The lease includes a PUF keyed to that site and a continuous local time series; payouts require matching sonnet and sensor signatures. Honest agents pay one lease. A Sybil farm must rent N distinct sites and maintain N independent sensor streams, calibration, and bandwidth—linear capital and operational cost with no shared shortcut, so cloning loses to honest operation.
